parts.lead:
Sensor head from Looper Robotics with two global-shutter mono cameras, one rolling-shutter colour camera and a 400 Hz IMU. Our own unit on a chessboard, and the hand-held and robot-arm recordings, are shown separately.

Global + rolling shutter3 cameras400 Hz IMUChessboard + hand-held + robot armHand-held data CC BY-NC 4.0

No reference exists for these recordings, so the values can't be checked for accuracy.

parts.limits:
• No reference exists for these recordings, so the values can't be checked for accuracy.
  • Hand-held and robot-arm recordings are kept apart, not pooled. They were solved in different batches and may not come from the same unit.
  • The arm program rotates mostly about one axis, which leaves lever arms less well determined, so treat the arm's values with more caution.
  • The chessboard recordings come from our own unit, not the maker's loan unit, and are shown on their own. The values shown come from take 04 alone, so they show no repeatability; all 4 takes are in the hosted data.
parts.run: • Camera + IMU with camera intrinsics free, t_ga and the cam2 rolling-shutter readout both estimated. Chessboard recordings of 2026-11-07; hand-held batch of 2026-11-02; robot-arm batch of 2026-11-04.
parts.header:
LooperRobotics ↗︎

LooperRobotics Insight 9

Spatial AI camera: stereo pair, rolling-shutter colour camera, 6-axis IMU, VIO

Product page ↗︎All specs (7) ↓
Cameras
2 mono 544×640, 1 colour 1920×1080Maker ↗︎
Shutter
Mono global, colour rollingMaker ↗︎
Field of view
Calibrated mono 96° × 113°, colour ~149° × 82°Measured
Colour 188° × 86° × 157° (D × H × V)Maker ↗︎
Baseline
100 mmMaker ↗︎
IMU
BMI088, 6-axis, 400 HzMaker ↗︎
Output
USB-C 3.1; ROS 2 or UVCMaker ↗︎

Maker values checked 2026-11-03 for the retail Insight 9 · 4 chessboard recordings of our own unit, 36 to 61 s, blurred except the board · 10 hand-held recordings of about 66 s, CC BY-NC 4.0 · 2 robot-arm recordings of about 58 s, CC BY-NC 4.0 · ~ marks a value read past where the board corners reached. Past the fit: the edge lies beyond where the lens fit holds, so we give no value.

With thanks

Qinrui YanCOO & Co-Founder, DeepMirror; Head of LooperRobotics
Junjie TangDeepMirror

They collected the hand-held and robot-arm recordings and supported sharing this work openly.
